512-4091-5457.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-5457.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-4186-4359-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2033-2060-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2033-2060-4687.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4871-5220-5651-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5651-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-5651-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

129-1978-4045-5793.description:
Activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Ur-Golem's Eye which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

147-7495.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for All Aboard.
147-7495.description:
Cast All Aboard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying All Aboard, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of All Aboard, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1902-6791.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-6791.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

877-2511-3081-3817.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4478-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-4478-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4478-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-3147-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-3147-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods

5478-5702-5954-7288.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

3678-5873-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5873-6879.description:
Play Everglades.
When Everglades enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Everglades.
Resolve the Everglades trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Everglades from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1115-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2558-5226-5346-5433.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability from step 1.
Repeat.

443-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Magus of the Bridge trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

5153-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
5153-5470.description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4284--39.notablePrerequisites: Clone is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4284--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Clone trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1849-3259-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
"Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
1849-3259-4302-4875.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

3011-3231-3333.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-3231-3333.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and no damage to you.

3263-4246.description:
Mycosynth Lattice turns all permanents into artifacts.
Activated abilities can not be activated due to Null Rod.
